body.name: Finite-support simultaneous-marginal perturbation handle
body.construction: Fix \(\mathcal G_{q,d}=\{g_1,\ldots,g_{q_{\mathrm{fr}}}\}\subset\mathbb B_d\). Choose an integer \(s\), positive rational baseline masses \(p_{kj}\), a rational amplitude \(\delta>0\), and signed directions \(h_{k\ell j}\) satisfying \(\sum_jh_{k\ell j}=0\) and \(p_{kj}+\delta\sum_{\ell=1}^s\theta_\ell h_{k\ell j}\ge0\). For each \(\theta\in\Theta_0\cup\Theta_1\), set \(P_{k,\theta}=\sum_{j=1}^{q_{\mathrm{fr}}}[p_{kj}+\delta\sum_{\ell=1}^s\theta_\ell h_{k\ell j}]\delta_{g_j}\) and \(\mathbf P_\theta=(P_{1,\theta},\ldots,P_{K,\theta})\). Solve each finite primal--dual MOT pair; for its declared contact-column set \(\mathcal C_\theta\) and dual tuple \(f^\theta\), record \(\mathfrak g_{\mathrm{rem}}=\min_{\theta}\min_{(j_1,\ldots,j_K)\notin\mathcal C_\theta}[c_K(g_{j_1},\ldots,g_{j_K})-\sum_{k=1}^Kf_k^\theta(g_{j_k})]\), together with \(\Delta_{N,K}\) and \(\operatorname{TV}_{\mathrm{mix}}\).
